send_email.description: Send an email through any mail server, using the SMTP details your provider gives you. Set the server, the sign-in, who it is from and to, and the message, with files from earlier steps attached. Store the password as a workspace secret and reference it so it is never stored in the workflow. For a mailbox Lodol already connects to, such as Gmail or Outlook, use that app's own send action instead.
send_email.name: send_email

parameters.description: The SMTP server to send through, such as smtp.example.com. Your email provider lists it under its SMTP or outgoing mail settings.
parameters.name: host

parameters.description: The port the server listens on. Leave it empty for the usual one: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL/TLS, 25 for none.
parameters.name: port

parameters.description: How the connection is secured. STARTTLS suits port 587 and most providers; SSL/TLS suits port 465. None sends in the clear, for a server on your own network only: it won't sign in to a server on the internet.
parameters.name: security

parameters.description: The account to sign in with, usually the full email address. Leave it empty for a server that needs no sign-in.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: The account's password or app password. Store it as a workspace secret and reference it here, for example @secrets.SMTP_PASSWORD, so it is never stored in the workflow.
parameters.name: password

parameters.description: Who the email is from. A name is allowed, as in Jane Doe <jane@example.com>. Most servers only send from the address signed in with.
parameters.name: sender

parameters.description: Who to send to. Separate several addresses with commas, or reference a list from an earlier step; a name is allowed, as in Jane Doe <jane@example.com>.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Who else to send to, visibly. Separate several addresses with commas.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: Who else to send to, without the other recipients seeing. Separate several addresses with commas.
parameters.name: bcc

parameters.description: Where replies should go, if not to the sender. Separate several addresses with commas.
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.description: The message as plain text. Fill in this, the HTML body, or both.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: A formatted version of the message, as HTML. Mail apps that can show it do; the plain text body is kept for the rest.
parameters.name: html_body

parameters.description: Files to attach, such as a PDF an earlier step made or downloaded. Upload one, or use a file from an earlier step. Up to 20 files.
parameters.name: attachments

description: Send email through any mail server.
